marketplace.name: ellmos
marketplace.description: Plugins from the ellmos ecosystem: coordination for mixed agent teams, workflow gates and reusable skills.

plugins.name: ellmos-lock-master
plugins.description: File-based locks for mixed agent teams: hooks block edits and pushes a foreign lock covers; /lock, /unlock, /locks.
plugins.compatibility_note: Hooks and commands need Claude Code. The LOCK*.txt convention itself is readable by any agent and by humans.

plugins.name: workflowhooker
plugins.description: Workflow gates that measure the project state: closing gate with one rework round, drift and scope warnings.
plugins.compatibility_note: Hooks and command need Claude Code; Codex and Kimi through workflowhooker's own hook snippets.

plugins.name: ellmos-dev-quality
plugins.description: Skills for systematic bug work, section-by-section merges, safe renames and pre-publication checks.
examples: "Run a systematic bug sweep over this repository and list the findings by area." (bugsweep)
"main and my feature branch both changed the parser; merge them without dropping either side's work." (zipper-merge)
"Customers are charged too much when a coupon is applied - find the cause and fix it." (bugfix-protocol)
plugins.compatibility_note: Agent Skills format, usable by any Agent Skills client. No package installs.

plugins.name: ellmos-mermaid-lint
plugins.description: Checks Mermaid blocks in Markdown with the real Mermaid parser and confirms on the GitHub page that they render.
examples: "GitHub shows 'Unable to render rich display' in docs/ - find and fix the broken Mermaid diagrams." (mermaid-lint)
plugins.compatibility_note: Agent Skills format, usable by any Agent Skills client. Needs node and git and installs its npm dependencies (mermaid, jsdom, playwright-core) when run, so it is offered in this marketplace only and not in the Claude directory.

plugins.name: ellmos-decision-kit
plugins.description: Skills to prepare, compare, sequence and sign off decisions: options with a clear recommendation, dependency maps and one-piece drafts.
examples: "Our clinic app needs authentication: build our own, Auth0 or self-hosted Keycloak? GDPR and EU hosting, about 300 EUR a month, little ops capacity. Decide." (decide)
"We have collected six open decisions for the release - list them with options and a clear recommendation each." (decision-briefing)
"Show how these pending decisions depend on each other and which one to settle first." (decision-path)
plugins.compatibility_note: Agent Skills format, text only, no scripts or network access.
